in_arabic.name: شيرين
in_arabic.long_meaning: شيرين هي اسم علم مؤنث من أصل فارسي، وتعني الحلوة أو اللطيفة. اشتقت من الفارسية وتعبر عن الجمال واللطف. في الثقافة الإسلامية، يعتبر اسم شيرين رمزًا للجمال والرقة.

in_urdu.name: شیرین
in_urdu.meaning: شیرین کا مطلب ہے میٹھا یا خوشگوار
in_urdu.long_meaning: شیرین فارسی سے ماخوذ اسم ہے جس کا مطلب ہے میٹھا یا خوشگوار۔ یہ نام اسلامی ثقافت میں خوبصورتی اور رقت کی علامت کے طور پر استعمال ہوتا ہے۔ فارسی زبان میں اس کا مطلب خوش گفتار یا میٹھی زبان والا بھی ہے۔

in_hindi.name: शिरीन
in_hindi.meaning: शिरीन का अर्थ है मीठी या प्रिय
in_hindi.long_meaning: शिरीन एक फारसी नाम है जिसका अर्थ है मीठी या प्रिय। यह नाम मुस्लिम समुदाय में सुंदरता और सादगी का प्रतीक है। फारसी भाषा में यह नाम मधुर वाणी या प्रियतमा के अर्थ में भी प्रयोग होता है।

in_pashto.name: شيرين
in_pashto.long_meaning: شيرين د پښتو ژبې يو نوم دی چې معنی يې خوږه يا ښه ده. دا نوم د افغان او پښتني کلتور په ميراث کې د ښځو لپاره کارول کېږي او د مينې او رقت نښه ګڼل کېږي.

in_english.name: Shirin
in_english.long_meaning: Shirin is a Persian-originated name meaning sweet or lovely. Etymologically derived from Persian roots, it signifies beauty and gentleness. In Islamic tradition, Shirin symbolizes pleasantness and kindness. Historically, it has been used across various Muslim cultures to denote endearment and charm.

data.cultural_impact: The name Shirin carries an exotic and alluring allure, stemming from its Persian origin. It is often associated with the Middle Eastern, Iranian, and Islamic culture, representing the beautiful and intoxicating elements of their tradition. This name might evoke imagery of beautiful gardens brimming with flowers, or the intoxicating aroma of Persian delicacies, given its meaning of 'sweet'. The name also carries the artistic connotation of 'beauty' and 'grace'. Shirin has also been used as a name for various characters in Persian folklore, mythology, and literature, adding to its rich history and symbolism.
data.spiritual_significance: In Sufism, a branch of Islam focused on the spiritual aspects of religion, the name Shirin can symbolize the sweetness and delight of the divine presence, and the inner longing or yearning for that connection. The name can represent the fareeqah of Allah, or the garden of the believer, where the fruits of faith and love for the Creator are abundant. The spiritual aspect of the name Shirin can inspire one to cultivate a sweet and kind disposition, and to seek the spiritual sweetness and fulfillment that comes from the connection to the Divine.
